messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for org=nebula-tech (org_id=nebula-1). Error rate > 20% on text-generation path, sustained 3m. Paging SRE on-call.

mike: saw it on graphs. 5xx spikes on v1/generate. latency up too.

carmen: tagging in — I'm pulling traces. is this traffic pattern bot-like or real traffic?

sre-jen: @carmen initial traces show huge fanout of short requests (prompt length small) at ~600 qps; mostly same prompt repeated. Could be a customer test or runaway loop.

mike: Nebula runs a nightly ingest + sampling test, might be misconfigured. Their support said they were ramping.

lia: impact: errors hitting 30% for the org; per-org SLA risk. We should apply immediate mitigation to protect platform. Options: temp throttle, bump quota, or route to cheaper model variant while preserving throughput.

mike: I'd prefer to avoid full org-wide throttle if we can. Suggest 1) switch Nebula's requests to the smaller backbone (gpt-small-sparse) behind the scenes, 2) apply a short quota bump so their sampler finishes, 3) enable org-level request dedupe for 60s.

carmen: can we do model-variant routing live? ops-bot has an override if we call it.

ops-bot: @mike @carmen ops-bot here. To change routing for an org: run the admin route command and the change will be active immediately across the gateway. Requires SRE/admin perms.

sre-jen: I'll run both the routing change + temporary qps bump, then monitor. Handing off to Tilly for observation after.

mike: commands (running now):
```
# set org routing to cheaper model variant
rwctl routing set --org nebula-1 --route "model=gpt-small-sparse,priority=forced" --reason "emergency spike: preserve platform health"
# bump qps for 10m while sample completes
rwctl quota update --org nebula-1 --qps 1200 --duration 600 --reason "temporary bump during mitigation"
```

ops-bot: Executing rwctl...

ops-bot: rwctl routing set returned: OK (route_id: r-89a3). New route applied to nebula-1.

ops-bot: rwctl quota update returned: OK (quota_change_id: q-772). QPS now 1200 for 600s.

lia: seeing immediate drop in 5xx on the platform side (graphs: https://redwood/grafana/d/VPL/requests?org=nebula-1). Error rate down to 4% and latency trending back to baseline within 45s.

carmen: confirm Nebula's client is getting 200s? any degraded quality reports from them?

mike: I checked a couple of requests returned responses (shorter outputs) — quality lower but acceptable for now. This is a controlled fallback.

sre-jen: paging notes: made two mitigation changes (route -> gpt-small-sparse, quota bump). We'll keep both for 10 minutes then reassess. Creating temporary ticket to coordinate with account.

lia: @tilly-oncall I'm handing off monitoring to you for the next 20m. Watch QPS and 5xx and be ready to rollback quota if platform impact returns.

tilly-oncall: taking it. I'll alert if 5xx > 10% for >1m or platform error budget threatened.

carmen: communication note: we should DM Nebula's AM to say we've applied a temporary routing to a lower-capacity model to keep their tests running while we investigate. Also recommend they pause any ramp for now.

mike: DM sent to nebula_am@redwood: "Quick heads up: we observed a burst from your test run; we've temporarily routed your requests to a smaller model and bumped your QPS for 10m to let the job finish. Please pause further ramping and we can coordinate a follow-up. —Mike (SRE)"

ops-bot: deploy-bot: audit log entry created: {actor: ops-bot, action: routing_change, org: nebula-1, route_id: r-89a3, time: 1746643225}

ops-bot: deploy-bot: audit log entry created: {actor: ops-bot, action: quota_change, org: nebula-1, quota_change_id: q-772, time: 1746643230}

lia: post-mitigation checks: backend error rate stable, cpu/gpu load within thresholds, cache hit ratio unaffected. No cascade to other orgs.

sre-jen: note for the runbook: add a quick play for "cheaper-model fallback" as a mitigation next to throttle/bump. It's less disruptive to customers than a hard throttle in some cases.

tilly-oncall: we've reached the 10m mark. Both routing override and quota bump will expire in ~30s. Monitoring closely.

ops-bot: rwctl quota update returned: OK (quota_change_id: q-772 expired).

ops-bot: rwctl routing unset returned: OK (route_id: r-89a3 removed).

lia: after revert: Nebula 5xx back to baseline <1%. Throughput normal. No follow-on issues.

carmen: creating incident tracking ticket: INC-2026-NEBULA-321 with timeline, mitigation commands, and action items (customer follow-up, runbook update, recommend org-side guardrails).

mike: action items -> owner assignment:
- lia: follow up with AM + confirm Nebula will pause ramps (within 1h)
- sre-jen: investigate root cause and whether sampling job misconfig caused runaway (24h)
- carmen: runbook update for cheaper-model fallback (72h)
- tilly-oncall: retro on-call notes and handover (immediate)

tilly-oncall: I'll add monitoring annotations and close handoff once AM ack received.

mike: thumbs up. Good mitigation. Closing thread when ticket created and AM acked. :thumbsup:

carmen: AM acknowledged, asked for brief postmortem later. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
